name: Devra Korwin
biography: Devra Korwin is an American actress born in Los Angeles, California just a year after the Great Depression ended. Born Devera Ann Kline, she had a relatively late start in Hollywood, making her first appearance as herself on Playboy's Penthouse when she was 25. She is known for her work on Piranha 3D (2010), Maniac (2012) and CBS Repertoire Workshop (1960). She and Jud Taylor were married for 24 years and raised two children.
